regressions.skipReason: Unsafe cache-ancestor symlink test is platform-specific.

protocol.first: median of three fresh private V8-cache processes
protocol.repeat: median of nine subsequent fresh processes
protocol.prewarmed: both sides warmed before timing; warmup recorded separately
protocol.output: full and bounded tested on separate Windows runners, never subtracted to estimate rendering cost
protocol.profile: median first-request stages/spans; spans nest and are not additive. Output diagnostics are opt-in; baseline has none.
protocol.limitations: Hosted Windows, short disposable TEMP and direct Node invocation; office-laptop AV, PowerShell/.cmd and native hook latency are not measured.
